headword: {西郷隆盛|さいごうたかもり}

definitions.explanation: A samurai from Satsuma (now Kagoshima) who helped overthrow the shogunate and arranged the peaceful surrender of Edo Castle. He later led the Satsuma Rebellion against the new government and died in its final battle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上野|うえの}→上野：28394_ueno⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{西郷隆盛|さいごうたかもり}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{銅像|どうぞう}→銅像：14471_douzou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a statue of Saigō Takamori in Ueno.

examples.japanese: {西郷隆盛|さいごうたかもり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鹿児島|かごしま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出身|しゅっしん}→出身：03221_shusshin⟧だ。

{西郷隆盛|さいごうたかもり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明治維新|めいじいしん}→明治維新：16286_meijiishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{立役者|たてやくしゃ}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{西南戦争|せいなんせんそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{新政府|しんせいふ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{戦|たたか}って→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧。
examples.english: Saigō Takamori was a key figure in the Meiji Restoration, but in the end he died fighting the new government in the Satsuma Rebellion.

notes:
In Kagoshima he is affectionately called {西郷|せご}どん.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{上野|うえの}→上野：28394_ueno⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{西郷|さいごう}さん: his bronze statue with his dog in Ueno Park, a Tokyo landmark
- {西南戦争|せいなんせんそう}: the Satsuma Rebellion of 1877
- {江戸城|えどじょう}{無血開城|むけつかいじょう}: the bloodless surrender of Edo Castle, which he negotiated with {勝海舟|かつかいしゅう}
